video.title: AI欧腐《兽王的新郎/Groom of the Beast‑King》
video.desc:
Young human Lynn cross-dresses as a woman and ventures into the orc realm to save his sister. At an auction, he accidentally triggers a Fated Bond with the ruthless Beast King. From hiding his male identity to laying their hearts bare, Lynn successfully turns the Beast King’s heart, sparking a romantic comedy of mutual devotion.
人类少年林恩为救妹妹，伪装成女性潜入兽人王国。在一场拍卖会上，他不慎与冷酷无情的兽王意外触发了“命定羁绊”。从小心翼翼隐瞒男儿身，到最终彼此开诚布公，林恩成功融化了兽王的心，展开了一场双向奔赴的浪漫爱情喜剧。
